subject: Request: BrightBank personnel evidence for SOC 2 readiness
messages:
From: Angela Wu <angela.wu@brightbank.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightBank SOC2 Team <soc2@brightbank.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: personnel evidence for SOC 2 readiness

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of BrightBank's SOC 2 due diligence we need a short package of personnel controls evidence covering onboarding/offboarding and training for the past 12 months. Our auditor has asked for the following items:

- Company-wide security training roster (names, training date, completion status)
- Sample redacted background check results and confirmation of vendor used (vendor name + attest letter)
- Onboarding checklist template and an example completed checklist (redacted PII)
- Deprovisioning timeline and proof of last 6 offboards (date of termination, access removal timestamps)
- HR attestation letter confirming background check policy and redaction process

We prefer a secure Drive folder link or SFTP for delivery. If any items will contain candidate PII that cannot be shared, please provide redacted samples and your redaction process document. Target date for delivery: 2027-09-10 (our audit window opens the week of 9/13).

Quick clarifying Qs:
1) Do you perform background checks in-house or via a vendor? If vendor, can you supply a confirmation letter on vendor letterhead?
2) Do you keep timestamps for account deprovisioning in a log we can reference?

I've attached the auditor's evidence checklist (BrightBank_SOC2_AuditChecklist_v2.pdf) for reference.

Thanks,
Angela Wu
Senior Security Analyst
BrightBank
attachments: BrightBank_SOC2_AuditChecklist_v2.pdf (pdf)

Subject: Fwd: Request: personnel evidence for SOC 2 readiness — BrightBank (action items)

Marissa / Ben,

Fwd'ing BrightBank's request — they want a compact evidence bundle by 9/10. Please coordinate below tasks:

- Marissa: pull the security training roster for the last 12 months and export completion statuses (include course IDs and timestamps). Put in CSV, redact DOB/SSNs.
- Ben: confirm our background check vendor and obtain the vendor confirmation letter on letterhead. Export a redacted sample of a vendor report (remove PII; keep scope and verification sections).
- Karthik: provide the standard onboarding checklist template and confirm where we store deprovisioning timestamps (IAM logs / HR system).

Also flag any audits or legal holds that would prevent redaction. I will own the reply and assemble the Drive folder.

Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: personnel evidence for SOC 2 readiness — BrightBank

Olga — quick update and attached manifest.

What I attached:
- onboarding_evidence_manifest.csv (columns: employee_id, role, start_date, training_complete_date, background_check_vendor, background_check_date, deprovision_date_if_applicable)
- redaction_instructions.md (high-level redaction steps we used: mask SSN, remove DOB, map PII to placeholder tokens)

Notes:
- Training roster exported from LMS: personnel-training-roster.csv (rows include employee alias, course_id, completion_timestamp). I removed DOB and national ID.
- Background checks are performed via CheckVerity, we have a template confirmation letter (attached as background_vendor_confirmation.pdf). Vendor confirms they will provide 'verification only' results and we can share redacted samples.
- Deprovisioning evidence: our IAM logs include explicit account disable timestamps; I pulled a 6-person sample for the requested window. Those entries will be redacted to remove usernames but include timestamps and systems acted on.

Timeline: I can stage a Drive folder and share a link by EOD 2027-09-08. If BrightBank needs native Excel, we can provide both CSV and XLSX.

Subject: Re: Request: personnel evidence for SOC 2 readiness — BrightBank (delivery)

Hi Angela,

Per BrightBank's checklist, we've assembled a redacted personnel evidence bundle and staged it in a secure Drive folder. Items delivered in the Drive link below:

1) personnel-training-roster.csv — exported from our LMS, PII redacted; includes course IDs and completion timestamps.
2) onboarding_evidence_manifest.csv — mapping of onboarding artifacts and sample completed checklist (redacted).
3) redaction_instructions.md — our redaction policy and steps used on samples.
4) background_vendor_confirmation.pdf — letter from CheckVerity confirming vendor role and allowed sharing scope.
5) background_sample_redacted.pdf — vendor report with PII masked.
6) deprovisioning_log_samples.csv — six offboard entries with account disable timestamps (usernames replaced with placeholders).
7) HR_attestation_signed.pdf (DocuSign) — HR attestation that background checks and redaction process were followed for provided samples.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/fakeid/brightbank-evidence-2027
DocuSign attestation: https://app.docusign.com/sign/FAKE-DOCUSIGN-ATT-12345

If you need anything in a different format (native Excel, encrypted SFTP drop), let me know and we can accommodate. We redacted candidate PII as requested; the redaction_instructions.md explains our approach and the token mapping we applied.

Thanks for the quick turnaround request — please confirm receipt and whether the auditor needs any additional context or a short walkthrough call.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
